{{Quote|First and foremost, Xim, Son of Xer, you are charged with causing the extermination and extinction of nine sentient species.''"<br />"''Nine? I know I spaced more than that.''"<br />"''Among them the Qadel, the Ermi, the Veeza, and the Zoa'mon&hellip;''"<br />"''Slavers all. I did the galaxy a favor.|Rexrax Shool accuses Xim during his trial in the play ''Evocar''|<ref name="Xim Week 4" />}}
The '''Zoa'mon''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. According to the play [[Evocar (play)|''Evocar'']], which was written by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Author/Legends|playwright]] [[Direus'pei]]<ref name="Xim Week 4" /> between [[920 BBY]] and [[671 BBY]],<ref name="Evocar date">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek05/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part IV: ''Evocar'')|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}} dates [[Direus'pei]] [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] to [[920 BBY]] and [[Death/Legends|death]] to [[671 BBY]]. Therefore, the play [[Evocar (play)|''Evocar'']] must have been written between those [[Standard year/Legends|years]].</ref> the Zoa'mon were driven to [[Death/Legends|extinction]] by the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] during his [[Xim's Expansionist Period|conquests]]<ref name="Xim Week 4" /> of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] that occurred between [[25,130 BBY|25,130]] and [[25,100 BBY]].<ref name="The History of Xim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}} dates the end of [[Xim/Legends|Xim's]] predecessor [[Xer VIII]] to [[25,130 BBY]] and the end of Xim's reign to [[25,100 BBY]].</ref> In the play, Xim was captured and placed on trial by the [[Hutt Empire]], during which he justified the extinction of the Zoa'mon and other species by arguing that they were all [[Slaver/Legends|enslavers]]. However, according to ''[[The Despotica]]'', a collection of literary works about Xim and his conquests, Direus'pei disregarded accepted history while writing ''Evocar'' to use Xim and other famous figures as a [[Politics/Legends|political]] screed to excoriate the Hutts' continued subjugation of the [[Evocii]], a species [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to<ref name="Xim Week 4" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="Xim Week 4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zoa'mon were mentioned in the fourth part of [[Michael Kogge]]'s article series ''[[Xim Week: The Despotica]]'', which was published as an exclusive article on [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|''Hyperspace'']] on [[December 11]], [[2009]].<ref name="Xim Week 4" />
